description: Generative AI makes new text, pictures, sound or code from learned patterns. Learn how to describe a task, inspect a result and recognise limits using small worked examples. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain text can sound right and be wrong
Explain ground an answer in source text
Explain picture prompts describe visible things
learningObjectives: Practise generated code needs a test
Practise variation is part of generation

seo.title: Generative AI Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Generative AI with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
